reviewed_interpretation: Fresh I022 public-development evidence is valid and shipping-mirror exact. Low-local evidence again dominates false negatives: 8779/9367 frames (93.72%). Of those low-local false negatives, 5201/8779 (59.24%) already have upstream speech probability above the unchanged 0.55 shipping upstream guard, confirming upstream/local disagreement is common. However replacing only the adaptive local noise state with the per-case oracle-labeled true-noise-state median while preserving the shipping local-evidence mapping and 0.15 local guard makes only 1312/8779 (14.94%) low-local false negatives pass; 7467/8779 (85.05%) remain reference-fail. The largest quadrant is upstream-high/reference-fail at 4499/8779 (51.25%). Therefore adaptive noise-state elevation is not a sufficient explanation for most low-local false negatives, and directly lowering/bypassing the local guard is not justified because I022 does not yet quantify how often upstream-high/local-low disagreement occurs on non-speech frames.

cross_slice_review.reviewed_interpretation: The same qualitative result persists across all seven noise domains and across -5/0/5/10/15 dB SNR plus reverb/anechoic and clean-preservation slices: low-local false negatives remain dominant, upstream-high disagreement is substantial, and the diagnostic true-noise-state reference rescues only a minority.

proposed_followup_hypothesis.rationale: I022 shows upstream-high/local-low disagreement is common on false negatives while adaptive noise-state normalization rescues only a minority. Before any local-guard bypass or upstream-trust candidate can be justified, measure the same upstream-high/local-low state on oracle-labeled non-speech frames and quantify its conditional speech precision, noise occupancy, temporal refresh/hangover behavior, and cross-domain stability using new fresh public-development authority.

verification_limits: I022 is candidate-zero and uses development-only oracle labels for diagnosis; its true-noise-state reference is not a shipping estimator or selected algorithm.

The reference counterfactual changes only the denominator noise-state reference while preserving the shipping local-evidence mapping and 0.15 local guard; reference-pass therefore means state elevation is sufficient to explain that frame, not that such a replacement should ship.
I022 does not count upstream-high/local-low occupancy on non-speech frames as a dedicated conditional-risk population, so it cannot justify bypassing the local guard based on upstream probability.
The artifact contains per-case/per-slice aggregate evidence but no raw frame trace archive or audio.
